retro:
# Retrospective

## Worked

Bounded security intake preceded fresh reviewer launches. Model/effort/native identities were verified: Opus 5.5 High through Claude Code, Sol Xhigh through Pi, Astra Medium coordination. Equivalent neutral scopes and separate saved reports preserved independence. The small Sol fixture directly answered the important behavior question without desktop access or a substitute GUI. No finding quota or generic public test request was added.

## Deviations and remediation

Opus's broad fixtures had omitted final-target assertions, producer/status gates, summary-write gates, incomplete nested helper pre-audit and overwritten nested logs. An initial observer errexit bug was preserved in a failed bundle and corrected in a separate run, but the corrected run retained the other omissions. Coordinator audit requested a separate process record, not silent revisions to the independent report. All Opus runtime conclusions and broad totals are excluded from public claims. Valid independent Sol evidence supports the narrow comparison, and completed independent source assessments support technical synthesis. No unresolved public claim depends on the invalid broad runs.

Future fixtures must assert each final resolved mutation and redirection target, gate every setup/producer and postcondition, and instrument any nested repository test into a disposable private copy when individual nested results are to be cited. A top-level zero exit or seal is not proof. Keep process compliance false for this round; no evidence was deleted. No out-of-root mutation is evidenced, but containment does not substitute for these guards.

## Limits and tools

No desktop resources were used. GUI/application hooks, alternative filesystems, concurrency and crash recovery remain untested. There is no confirmed tooling bug to file from this assignment: fixture guard errors belong to the review process, not the PR or review.py. Native agent transcripts are preserved in normal session storage; private links stay out of public comment/HTML.

## Close

Stop further substitute experiments because the important public conclusion is independently supported and other claims are explicitly bounded. Fresh editorial-only Astra Medium gate covers exact final draft and privacy-inclusive immutable requirements. Save HTML without opening; outer assistant alone handles fresh upstream publication checks.
